blocks.text: North Korean state media published photographs of leader Kim Jong Un on Tuesday (October 20, 2026), reporting that he had visited a clothing and footwear exhibition in Pyongyang on October 19 as unverified claims about his death circulated online. The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) showed Kim Jong Un accompanied by his wife, Ri Sol Ju, and daughter, Kim Ju Ae, according to Yonhap. The exhibition account provides a more recent reported appearance than the October 11 museum visit cited in earlier coverage of the rumors.
